definitions.text: Number of covalent bonds that a monomer molecule or monomeric unit in a macromolecule or oligomer molecule can form with other reactants.

notes.2: If f = 2, a linear chain macromolecule or a macrocycle can be formed.
notes.3: If f > 2, a branch point can be formed leading to a branched macromolecule, a network or a micronetwork.
